name: Four Seasons Les Chalets du Mont d’Arbois , Megeve
insider_take: Perched at 3,800 feet in the French Alps, this ultra-luxe chalet collection sits on the very slopes where legendary skier Emile Allais perfected his technique – you're literally staying on Olympic-caliber terrain.
whats_special: This is the only Four Seasons property where you can ski directly from your chalet door onto the pristine Princesse piste. The resort sits on the historic Mont d'Arbois domain, once the private skiing retreat of the Rothschild family, offering exclusive access to some of Europe's most coveted powder runs.
pro_tip: Book the Edmond de Rothschild chalet – it features the original family's private ski room and offers direct access to the secret "Liaison" trail that connects to Saint-Gervais, avoiding the crowded main slopes entirely.
dont_miss: The après-ski ritual at Le Bistrot, where Michelin-starred cuisine meets mountain views, and the heated infinity pool that seems to float above the Chamonix valley – especially magical during evening snowfall when the lights of Megève village twinkle below.
pros: Authentic Alpine chalet architecture with luxury Four Seasons service
Prime ski-in/ski-out location on Mont d'Arbois slopes
World-class spa and wellness facilities with mountain views
Exceptional dining experiences featuring local French Alpine cuisine
cons: Seasonal operation primarily during winter ski season
